--- header_pre ---
#define y0 _y0
#define y1 _y1
#include <stddef.h>
#if defined(__APPLE__)
#include <OpenGL/gl.h>
#include <OpenGL/glu.h>
#include <GLUT/glut.h>
#else
#define GL_GLEXT_PROTOTYPES
#include <GL/gl.h>
#include <GL/glext.h>
#include <GL/glu.h>
#include <GL/freeglut.h>
#endif
#include <math.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#undef y0
#undef y1

#ifndef M_PI
#define M_PI 3.14159265358979323846
#endif

static float g_angle = 0.0f;
static int   g_rotating = 0;

--- gl_vector_helpers ---
/* C89 replacements for C99 compound GL literals. */

static GLfloat *repl_glfloat3(GLfloat a, GLfloat b, GLfloat c) {
  static GLfloat repl_glfloat3_buf[3];
  repl_glfloat3_buf[0] = a;
  repl_glfloat3_buf[1] = b;
  repl_glfloat3_buf[2] = c;
  return repl_glfloat3_buf;
}

static GLfloat *repl_glfloat4(GLfloat a, GLfloat b, GLfloat c, GLfloat d) {
  static GLfloat repl_glfloat4_buf[4];
  repl_glfloat4_buf[0] = a;
  repl_glfloat4_buf[1] = b;
  repl_glfloat4_buf[2] = c;
  repl_glfloat4_buf[3] = d;
  return repl_glfloat4_buf;
}
--- display_header ---
void display(void) {
  glLoadIdentity();
  glPushAttrib(GL_ALL_ATTRIB_BITS);
--- lights_pre_camera ---
--- camera ---
  glTranslatef(0.0000f, 0.0000f, -5.0000f);   // @camera dist
  glRotatef(20.0000f, 1.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f);   // @camera rx
  glRotatef(30.0000f, 0.0f, 1.0f, 0.0f);   // @camera ry
  glTranslatef(-0.0000f, -0.0000f, -0.0000f);   // @camera pan
--- header_post ---
  float A[16], B[16], C[16];
--- source ---
static float size = 3; // surface width and depth @tune
static float steps = 15; // strips across the surface @tune
static float amplitude = 0.4; // wave height @tune
static float frequency = 2.5; // wave density @tune
static float z_phase = 0.7; // z waves animate more slowly @tune
static float step_size;
static float half;
static float x0, x1, z, y0, y1;
static float slope_x0, slope_x1, slope_z0, slope_z1;
static float color0, color1;


  // The same animated surface, now lit with one analytic normal per vertex.
  glClearColor(0.05, 0.06, 0.08, 1);
  glClear(GL_COLOR_BUFFER_BIT | GL_DEPTH_BUFFER_BIT);
  glEnable(GL_DEPTH_TEST);

  glEnable(GL_COLOR_MATERIAL);
  glLightModeli(GL_LIGHT_MODEL_TWO_SIDE, GL_TRUE);
  glMaterialfv(GL_FRONT_AND_BACK, GL_SPECULAR, (GLfloat[]){0.4, 0.4, 0.4, 1});
  glMaterialf(GL_FRONT_AND_BACK, GL_SHININESS, 30);
  glEnable(GL_LIGHTING);
  glEnable(GL_NORMALIZE);
  glEnable(GL_LIGHT0);
  glEnable(GL_LIGHT1);
  glEnable(GL_LIGHT2);
  glEnable(GL_LIGHT3);
  glShadeModel(GL_SMOOTH);

  step_size = size / steps;
  half = size * 0.5;

  for(i, 0, steps) {
    x0 = -half + i * step_size;
    x1 = x0 + step_size;

    glBegin(GL_TRIANGLE_STRIP);
      for(j, 0, steps + 1) {
        z = -half + j * step_size;

        y0 = amplitude * sin(x0 * frequency + t) * cos(z * frequency + z_phase * t);
        y1 = amplitude * sin(x1 * frequency + t) * cos(z * frequency + z_phase * t);

        // For y = f(x,z), the surface normal is (-df/dx, 1, -df/dz).
        // Emit the high-x edge first so the upward-facing triangles are CCW.
        slope_x1 = amplitude * frequency * cos(x1 * frequency + t) * cos(z * frequency + z_phase * t);
        slope_z1 = -amplitude * frequency * sin(x1 * frequency + t) * sin(z * frequency + z_phase * t);
        glNormal3f(-slope_x1, 1, -slope_z1);
        color1 = 0.5 + 0.5 * y1 / amplitude;
        glColor3f(1 - 0.85 * color1, 0.35 + 0.2 * color1, 0.2 + 0.8 * color1); // CORAL -> AZURE
        glVertex3f(x1, y1, z);

        slope_x0 = amplitude * frequency * cos(x0 * frequency + t) * cos(z * frequency + z_phase * t);
        slope_z0 = -amplitude * frequency * sin(x0 * frequency + t) * sin(z * frequency + z_phase * t);
        glNormal3f(-slope_x0, 1, -slope_z0);
        color0 = 0.5 + 0.5 * y0 / amplitude;
        glColor3f(1 - 0.85 * color0, 0.35 + 0.2 * color0, 0.2 + 0.8 * color0); // CORAL -> AZURE
        glVertex3f(x0, y0, z);
      }
    glEnd();
  }
--- render_state ---
  glEnable(GL_MULTISAMPLE);
  glDisable(GL_LINE_SMOOTH);
